Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.wallet

Record Class KfeColdWalletPsbtResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.wallet.KfeColdWalletPsbtResponse
Record Components:
workflowId - persisted cold-wallet workflow identifier
psbt - base64-encoded partially signed transaction awaiting offline signatures
psbtHash - digest used to bind review and signing to the exact PSBT contents
feeSats - network fee represented by the PSBT, in satoshis
amountSats - intended payment amount, in satoshis
destinationAddress - intended recipient address encoded in the transaction
inputs - wallet outpoints selected as funding inputs
public record KfeColdWalletPsbtResponse(UUID workflowId, String psbt, String psbtHash, long feeSats, long amountSats, String destinationAddress, List<KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest.Input> inputs) extends Record
Client response containing an unsigned cold-wallet PSBT and the data needed to review it offline. The serialized PSBT is paired with a digest and transaction summary so a signer can verify the intended transfer before returning signatures.
